WITH tx AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.is_credit, p.aci, p.eur_amount, p.issuing_country, p.acquirer_country, p.has_fraudulent_dispute,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL p.day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS month
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND p.year = 2023
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT month, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, 100 * SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fraud_pct
  FROM tx GROUP BY month
),
tx_b AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE WHEN m.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN m.vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN m.vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_band,
    CASE WHEN m.fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN m.fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN m.fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_band,
    IF(t.issuing_country = t.acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intracountry
  FROM tx t JOIN monthly m USING (month)
),
schemes AS (SELECT s AS scheme FROM UNNEST(['GlobalCard','NexPay','SwiftCharge','TransactPlus']) AS s),
matched AS (
  SELECT sc.scheme, t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM tx_b t CROSS JOIN schemes sc
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = sc.scheme
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intracountry)
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = t.vol_band)
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t.fraud_band)
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
   AND (IFNULL(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (IFNULL(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR 7993 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (IFNULL(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
),
diag AS (
  SELECT scheme, psp_reference, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, MIN(ID) AS rule_id, MIN(eur_amount) AS amt,
    MIN(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_first_rule
  FROM matched GROUP BY scheme, psp_reference
)
SELECT scheme,
  COUNT(*) AS tx_matched,
  COUNTIF(n_rules > 1) AS tx_multi_rule,
  ROUND(SUM(fee_first_rule), 2) AS total_fees_eur
FROM diag
GROUP BY scheme
ORDER BY total_fees_eur DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS tx_id, card_scheme, is_credit, aci,
    IF(issuing_country = acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intracountry,
    eur_amount, has_fraudulent_dispute,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mo
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT mo, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    100 * SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fr_vol,
    100 * AVG(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, 1, 0)) AS fr_cnt
  FROM base GROUP BY mo
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT 'vol' AS defn, mo,
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_b,
    CASE WHEN fr_vol < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fr_vol <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN fr_vol <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fr_b
  FROM monthly
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'cnt' AS defn, mo,
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END,
    CASE WHEN fr_cnt < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fr_cnt <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN fr_cnt <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END
  FROM monthly
),
fee_match AS (
  SELECT m.defn, b.tx_id, b.card_scheme, b.eur_amount, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM base b
  JOIN bucketed m ON b.mo = m.mo
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = b.card_scheme
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type),0)=0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code),0)=0 OR 7993 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci),0)=0 OR b.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = b.is_credit)
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = b.intracountry)
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = m.vol_b)
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = m.fr_b)
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT defn, tx_id, card_scheme, COUNT(*) AS n,
    AVG(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee
  FROM fee_match GROUP BY defn, tx_id, card_scheme
)
SELECT d.defn, b.card_scheme,
  COUNT(*) AS txns,
  SUM(IF(p.n IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS unmatched,
  SUM(IF(p.n > 1, 1, 0)) AS multi_matched,
  ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(p.fee, 0)), 2) AS total_fees_eur
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(['vol', 'cnt']) AS d(defn)
LEFT JOIN per_tx p ON p.tx_id = b.tx_id AND p.defn = d.defn AND p.card_scheme = b.card_scheme
GROUP BY d.defn, b.card_scheme
ORDER BY d.defn, total_fees_eur DESC

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, eur_amount, is_credit, aci,
    IF(issuing_country = acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intracountry,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS month,
    has_fraudulent_dispute
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT month,
    SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    100 * SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fraud_pct
  FROM tx GROUP BY month
),
tx2 AS (
  SELECT t.*,
    CASE WHEN m.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN m.vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN m.vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_bin,
    CASE WHEN m.fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN m.fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN m.fraud_pct < 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_bin
  FROM tx t JOIN monthly m USING (month)
),
matches AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.card_scheme, f.ID,
    f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM tx2 t
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f ON f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
  WHERE (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR 7993 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
    AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
    AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = t.vol_bin)
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t.fraud_bin)
    AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intracountry)
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, AVG(fee) AS fee
  FROM matches GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT t.card_scheme,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.psp_reference) AS n_tx_total,
  COUNTIF(p.psp_reference IS NOT NULL) AS n_tx_matched,
  COUNTIF(p.n_rules > 1) AS n_tx_multi_rule,
  SUM(p.fee) AS total_fee_eur
FROM tx2 t
LEFT JOIN per_tx p ON p.psp_reference = t.psp_reference AND p.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_fee_eur DESC

),

  SELECT p.*, pmx.vol_bucket, pmx.fraud_bucket, (p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country) AS is_intra
  FROM p JOIN pmx ON p.mth = pmx.mth

WITH mon AS (
  SELECT m, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fl
  FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS m, eur_amount, has_fraudulent_dispute
        FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023)
  GROUP BY m
),
bands AS (
  SELECT m,
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_band,
    CASE WHEN fl < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fl <= 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN fl <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_band
  FROM mon
),
t AS (
  SELECT p.eur_amount, p.is_credit, p.aci, (p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country) AS intra, b.vol_band, b.fraud_band
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  JOIN bands b ON EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL p.day_of_year - 1 DAY)) = b.m
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND p.year = 2023
),
s AS (SELECT DISTINCT card_scheme FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`)
SELECT s.card_scheme, COUNT(t.eur_amount) AS txn_rule_matches, ROUND(SUM(f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000), 2) AS total_fee
FROM t
CROSS JOIN s
JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
  ON f.card_scheme = s.card_scheme
  AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))

  AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t.fraud_band)

         WHEN mv.vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vb,
